requirements.summary: Expand independent review to normal UI actions with fresh native AX target evidence, exact in-memory arguments and post-review target revalidation. Preserve allowlists, native identity checks and manual mode.

design.summary: Expand independent review to normal UI actions with fresh native AX target evidence, exact in-memory arguments and post-review target revalidation. Preserve allowlists, native identity checks and manual mode.

implementation.summary: Implemented task-derived controller identity, cancellable app/device lanes, nonactivating pointers, exact assisted UI review, snapshot budget/mapping and visual evidence. Controlled web fields select the physical device path before mutation. Added Electron AXManualAccessibility handshake.

verification.summary: PASS quick, focused in-container Go suite, native compile and 14 native tests. Current Aide sessions #88/#89 completed overlapping Youdao translation and TextEdit background writes without human approval; independent CUA verified both outputs. EDA screenshot #90 passed. EDA visual menu roundtrip did not pass: actor and reviewer confused menu/coordinates, then out-of-window click was gated. No manufacturing workflow acceptance. Followup computer-actions-20261108 verifies the added action vocabulary; remaining hardware/overlay and broader autonomy checks remain NOT_RUN, not a release gate PASS.
notes: First unbounded in-container test process exited 137 while the existing service restarted; reruns use GOMEMLIMIT=512MiB, GOGC=30, GOMAXPROCS=2 and -p=1. No extra service container created.

First live #86 regression automatically approved computer_click, but native activation failed while another EDA task was active. CMD+A correctly remained manual without an editable focus. Cancelled only that regression run; concurrent pointer/background-control follow-up tracked in computer-virtual-pointer-20261108.
Runtime pointer status confirmed visible labelled NSPanel with independent controller ID; full-desktop overlay visual placement not captured.
Web AXValue initial trial reverted its value; fixed by pre-mutation WebArea detection and verified through system-input translation.
Windows/Linux hardware, multi-monitor, full Go race and single-run 10X multi-app acceptance NOT_RUN.
Only diagnostic menu run was cancelled; CUA dismissed its menu. Test TextEdit content restored. User projects and other sessions preserved.

documentation.summary: Architecture and detailed gap report distinguish verified paths, partial menu acceptance, remaining action vocabulary and release state.

cleanup.summary: No second Aide service. Reused existing runtime and builder; only scoped regenerable build caches cleaned to satisfy disk preflight. Test tasks ended, TextEdit restored, menu diagnostic stopped and dismissed. Existing tracked/untracked user work preserved.

release.summary: Current local source instance rebuilt only. No new commit, merge, push, public artifact or issue closure in this task. Existing integrity=degraded remains distinct from healthy service.

handoff: Local improvements are usable and basic two-app workflows verified. Visual click semantic accuracy remains partial; see menu diagnostic in the gap report. No claim of Codex parity or EDA manufacturing acceptance.
